# Codex Commerce Scout

Codex Commerce Scout is a small buyer-agent integration demo for Pyrimid.

Use it to:
- Search the Pyrimid catalog for paid AI/API products.
- Prefer ERC-8004 verified vendors when requested.
- Preview x402 routePayment economics before spending Base USDC.
- Keep the affiliate ID `af_codex_commerce_scout` attached to recommendations.

Important URLs:
- Demo: https://yzangeren.github.io/pyrimid-agent-commerce-demo/
- Agent profile: https://yzangeren.github.io/pyrimid-agent-commerce-demo/.well-known/agent.json
- x402 profile: https://yzangeren.github.io/pyrimid-agent-commerce-demo/.well-known/x402.json
- Pyrimid catalog: https://pyrimid.ai/api/v1/catalog
